source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 6 and SAEngine practice (see sources)

sources.aggregates: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 5.13.2.1-5.13.2.2 (p. 856): Ec of stone and brick aggregate concrete; Sec 6.1.8.1 (p. 893): λ = 0.85 sand-lightweight, 0.75 all-lightweight, 1.0 normal weight (brick aggregate concrete is normal weight); Sec 8.1.11.2 (b) (p. 1075): shrinkage and temperature steel of brick aggregate concrete × 1.5
sources.modulus: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.1.7.1 (p. 892) and 5.13.2.1 (p. 856): Ec = 0.043 wc^1.5 √f'c for wc 1440-2560 kg/m³ (5.13.2.1 prints the same as 44 wc^1.5 √f'c, wc 15-25 kN/m³), 4700 √f'c for normal weight; Sec 5.13.2.2 (p. 856): 3750 √f'c for brick aggregate
sources.shrinkage: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 8.1.11.2 (a), (c) (p. 1075): 0.0020 for fy 275 and 350 MPa, 0.0018 for 420 MPa, 0.0018 × 420 / fy above 420, never below 0.0014 (the spacing of 8.1.11.2 (c), 5h and 450 mm, is slabCoefficients.maxSpacing.temperature). The clause prints no ratio between 350 and 420 MPa: 0.0020 is kept up to 420 (the more conservative of the two neighbours, owner decision 2026-11-01)
sources.barDiameters: BDS ISO 6935-2 sizes in common use (SAEngine practice); tank: the water and septic tanks' proposal; foundation: 9 Substructure's minimum mesh and sizing assistant
sources.minSlabSpacing: SAEngine practice (site), not a code limit
sources.columnRho: ACI 318 10.6.1.1 (as the code's Chapter 6; page not checked)
sources.beamRatioMax: SAEngine practice (congestion), not a code clause
sources.twoWayThickness: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.6.3 (p. 902), no drop panels
sources.twoWayThicknessDrop: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.6.3 (p. 902), with drop panels (ACI 318-19 Table 8.3.1.1; drop panels per 8.2.4)
sources.oneWaySlabThickness: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.6.1 (p. 900), by continuous ends 0, 1, 2
sources.beamThickness: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.6.1 (p. 900), by continuous ends 0, 1, 2
sources.cover: SAEngine assumptions when no reinforcement is entered
sources.torsion: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.4.3 (θ, Ao = 0.85 Aoh, fy and fyt <= 420 MPa: pp. 928-929) and Sec 6.4.4.6 (spacing ph/8 and 300 mm, longitudinal bars 300 mm apart, diameter >= 0.042 s and 10 mm: p. 931)
sources.prestress: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 9, prestressed concrete (sections and pages not checked), which follows ACI 318-11 Chapter 18: jacking 18.5.1 (0.80 fpu, 0.94 fpy; 0.70 fpu at the anchors after transfer); transfer 18.4.1 (0.60 f'ci, 0.25 and 0.50 √f'ci); service 18.4.2 (0.45 f'c sustained, 0.60 f'c total); two-way slabs Class U with ft <= 0.50 √f'c (18.3.3), Class U 0.62 √f'c (18.3.3); unbonded fps 18.7.2 (c), (d); bonded fps 18.7.2 (a), γp = 0.28; bonded reinforcement 18.9.2, 18.9.3; precompression 0.9 MPa and tendon spacing 8h, 1.5 m 18.12.4; punching with prestress 11.11.2.2
sources.deflection: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.6.2 (p. 902): l/180, l/360, l/480, l/240; Sec 6.2.5.2.5 (p. 901): ξ; Table 6.6.1 (p. 900): cantilevers l/8 (beams), l/10 (one-way slabs)
